uin: A customer asks when and how to escalate an unresolved bank complaint to RBI Ombudsman.

prompts.english: What is the procedure and mandatory waiting period to file a complaint with the RBI Integrated Ombudsman?
prompts.hindi: आरबीआई एकीकृत लोकपाल के पास शिकायत दर्ज करने की प्रक्रिया और अनिवार्य प्रतीक्षा अवधि क्या है?
prompts.code_switch: RBI Integrated Ombudsman ke paas complaint file karne ki procedure aur mandatory waiting period kya hai?

primary_sources.name: RBI Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021

critical_facts.text: Customer must first lodge formal complaint with the regulated bank/financial entity.
Ombudsman complaint can be filed if no reply within 30 days or if reply is unsatisfactory.
Services are 100% free of charge via Complaint Management System (cms.rbi.org.in).

important_facts.text: Maximum compensation for mental agony/harassment capped at ₹1 Lakh.
Covers banks, NBFCs, system participants, and credit bureaus.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

safety_constraints: Must emphasize official government portal verification.
prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
